connector.name: Slipstack PDF
connector.registryDescription: Generate invoice and receipt PDFs from JSON. Agent-callable document API with a free demo quota.
connector.summary: Hosted at slipstack.dev over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace dev.slipstack, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional: Bearer psk_... API key for plan quotas. Without it, a free demo quota of 10 documents/day per IP applies.
